name: Goitered gazelle
desc: A slender gazelle of open gravel plains and desert, and one of the most-recorded large herbivores near the park.
about: The goitered gazelle or black-tailed gazelle is a gazelle native to Turkey, Georgia, Azerbaijan, Iran, parts of Iraq and Pakistan, Afghanistan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan,…
